symptom: select Name, Excluded from CATALOG.snippets / CATALOG.layouts fails with 'no such column: Excluded', while CATALOG.pages has it; snippets.ParameterCount is always 0
cause: snippets_data and layouts_data were created without an Excluded column; the snippet reader already carried Excluded but the builder never wrote it, the layout reader (layoutFromGen) never read the stored flag, and the snippet insert passed a literal 0 for ParameterCount
insight: When one document type gains a column, grep its siblings' INSERTs for the same name: pages, snippets and layouts are built by three functions in one file and drift independently. A literal 0 passed for a count the reader already has is the same defect one column over, and reads as a fact. Two layers to prove: the reader must read the BSON flag (backend test that sets Excluded:true in the stored unit, with the as-written false as control) and the builder must write it (catalog test with a mock backend). Bump CatalogSchemaVersion, or every cached catalog keeps failing the query.
